title: Ever17 -the out of infinity-

versions.note: A PS2 emulator names this build SLPS-25149-6e86bb5a

sources: yomikata scan 0.2.0 of the disc files: shift_jis 2,409, utf16le 486 characters of prose-like text
The harness alone, from the game's file (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written
Played from power-on in the game's own auto mode: the prologue's first 130 lines, over five scenes
What the script said in play agreed with the lines read off 84 of 84 pictures, speakers too, over 5 scenes. No screen without a line was among them, and no choice
notes: Read by the script games/ps2/SLPS-25149.lua. A scene's script is loaded whole as Shift-JIS strings (which is why little of it reads on the disc: it is packed there), and the line shown is copied out to a fixed place, whole from its first frame; a word says how many of its first characters are the speaker's name. The engine's marks are %K, %P, %N, %p, %O and %T with a number. Choices, the backlog and menus aren't read.
